summary: Comprehensive revision of implementation plan and Singapore Design Guide for GaiGai. Incorporates feedback: removal of Chinese characters, proposals for 10 verified raiSE social enterprises across F&B, wellness, gifts, and experiences, axe/WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines, mobile/web responsiveness, and a detailed Singapore Design Guide inspired by Passion Made Possible, Peranakan motifs, and HDB/Kopitiam community culture.
